incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: eval-gate/output-drift triggered for prod-west (rule: eval-gate/support-summaries)
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PDR-1313 | Severity: P2 | Auto-assigned: maya | Created by eval-gate
maya: acked :raised_hand: I'll take this one and coordinate mitigation
maya: quick TL;DR — eval gate tripped for `support-summaries` prompt deck; output quality regression (rouge/hallucination) increased vs baseline
joan: fyi we promoted `redwood-gen-2.1` ~04:12 UTC this morning — possible regression introduced there
eva-ml: preliminary numbers from rolling evals: baseline ROUGE-L 0.42 -> 0.31; hallucinations per 1k queries 2.4 -> 14.9 (1h window)
sylas: infra check — cluster looks healthy, no OOMs or node failures. Not an infra CPU/GPU issue so far
ash: oncall-sre here, standing by for routing changes / rollback. can do immediate traffic pin to fallback model if you want
maya: plan of action (short):
- pin production traffic for `/v1/generate/support` to `redwood-gen-2.0` (rollback)
- disable canary promotions for the route
- monitor eval gate and customer signals for 10-15m
- start customer outreach for affected tenants
maya: running command now:
```
redwoodctl route update --route /v1/generate/support --model redwood-gen-2.0 --weight 100
```
ash: applying route update...
```
[2026-03-14T04:40:12Z] redwoodctl: applying route update for /v1/generate/support
[2026-03-14T04:40:14Z] redwoodctl: success - traffic now 100% -> redwood-gen-2.0
```
maya: ok change applied, monitoring eval gate and telemetry
tobi: quick customer-impact note — three enterprise tenants showing bad summaries (acct: acme, beta-corp, shoply). Errors are quality regressions (extraneous assertions), not PII or data-loss
joan: I'm DM'ing acme SME with examples and ETA for follow-up message
eva-ml: digging into eval diffs; looks like tokenization/special-token handling changed in gen-2.1 which impacts a subset of prompts (edge-case templates)
sylas: infra: no scaling events triggered; tail latency stable after routing change
maya: giving this 10m watch window to confirm reverting solves gate trip. If we see sustained improvement we'll keep pinned and schedule a rollback release/process to prevent re-promotion
ash: note: I've disabled automated canary promotions for that pipeline
maya: incident record: INC-2026-87 created (tracking ground-truth for postmortem)
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-87 created by maya | linked to PDR-1313
pagerduty-bot: PDR-1313 acknowledged by maya; escalation halted
ash: mitigation checklist update: traffic pinned ✅ canary disabled ✅ customer outreach started (joan) ✅ logging/traces collected ✅
maya: follow-ups (assigned):
- eva-ml: full prompt-eval run across 20k prompts overnight (priority)
- joan: customer-facing note + SME confirmations
- infra (sylas/ash): watch for any perf regressions or error spikes after routing change
- eng-release: block auto-promote for rollout until root cause fixed
joan: starting outreach now, will paste sample outputs here once SME responds
sylas: I'll keep watch for any SLO regressions, ping me if anything >3% error increase
ash: I'll update the incident ticket with mitigation details and handoff notes for overnight
maya: handing off active watch to ash for overnight (oncall until 0800 UTC). ash — you're the primary point of contact now
ash: taking handoff. will escalate to P1 and wake team if we see re-trips or customer-impact spike. leaving extended monitoring on dashboards
tobi: saved repro samples and failing eval outputs to /shared/incidents/INC-2026-87/samples (link: https://drive.internal/INC-2026-87/samples)
eva-ml: note to self: add stricter threshold and a tokenization sanity check to eval gate for this deck
maya: thanks all :pray: I'll check back after 15m; if stable we'll mark mitigation complete and keep the incident open for RCA/postmortem
ash: acknowledged, will post updates if anything changes
maya: closing active mitigation window now; moving to watch/triage mode
ash: confirmed handoff and watching — will update ticket and postmortem skeleton in the morning
maya: thanks everyone
